This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Announcement" />

==Biology and appearance==
This diminutive<ref name="Make It Stop" /> [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|tan]] wrinkled skin, small black [[eye]]s, and elongated [[Mouth|snouts]].<ref name="Announcement" />

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:Anteater-Like-And-Pointy-Headed-Species.png|left|200px|thumb|A member of this species within the Lina Soh Hospital.]]
In [[5 BBY]], a member of this species was enjoying the [[Niamos Beach|beaches]] of the [[planet]] [[Niamos]] with an older [[human]] when [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] was wrongly arrested by the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Announcement" /> Later, in [[1 BBY]], a member of this species was present within the [[Lina Soh Hospital]] on the planet [[Coruscant]], observing another [[Unidentified orange pointy-headed species|alien]] who was suspended within a [[bacta tank]], while [[Kleya Marki]] infiltrated the building in search of [[Luthen Rael]].<ref name="Make It Stop" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:UnidentifiedAnteaterLikeSpecies-IvanManzella.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art by Ivan Manzella.]]
This species first appeared in the [[Announcement|seventh episode]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', directed by [[Benjamin Caron]].<ref name="Announcement" /> This species was designed by concept artist and sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]].<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creature & Character Designs|author=[[Ivan Manzella|Manzella, Ivan]]|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20250715083228}}</ref>
